item.title: Tencent Launches Hy3 Globally With 295B-Parameter Agent-Ready Architecture
item.summary: Tencent launched Hy3 globally on August 5 — a 295B-parameter Mixture-of-Experts model with 21B active parameters and 256K context, deployed across WorkBuddy, Miora, TokenHub, and open-source platforms including OpenRouter and OpenClaw.
